label: Military & First Responders
heroHeading: Recovery equipment that stands up to shift work
seoDescription: Tactical recovery equipment for military installations & first responder facilities. Commercial-grade HBOT, cold therapy & red light built for durability.

valueProps.title: Group throughput
valueProps.body: Cold rooms and cabins sized for a crew, so a shift can go through together rather than one at a time.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Commercial builds and duty cycles, with parts and trained technicians in North America and Australia.

valueProps.title: Run by your own staff
valueProps.body: Training at handover, protocols in the app, and remote monitoring so a unit that needs attention is flagged before it goes down.

features.title: Planned around the watch
features.body: We lay the space out for shift changes: how many go through at once, and how long each session takes.

features.title: Hyperbaric under medical direction
features.body: Chambers are medical devices and need trained operators and clinical oversight. We supply them that way or not at all.
